en: Black-and-white postcard showing a sculptural fountain in a pond, with a classical-style statue of a seated female figure surrounded by reeds on a small island. In the background, people in early 20th‑century clothing stroll along a paved path next to the water, with trees and landscaped park areas behind them. Printed caption text appears at the bottom right and publisher information at the bottom left.
